text: Local governments across the United States have sued oil and gas companies, including ExxonMobil, over alleged harms from climate change.

source.name: Exxon Mobil Corporation: Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025 (SEC EDGAR)
source.quote: have filed a number of legal proceedings against several oil and gas companies, including ExxonMobil, requesting unprecedented legal and equitable relief for various alleged injuries purportedly connected to climate change

additionalSources.name: NBC News (Lawrence Hurley): Supreme Court takes up oil companies' plea to end climate change lawsuits
additionalSources.quote: Exxon Mobil and Suncor Energy are appealing a May 2025 Colorado Supreme Court ruling that said the lawsuit brought by the city of Boulder and Boulder County could move forward
